t: This is the statue of Lord Lawrence, on the southeastern corner of Waterloo Place and Carlton House Terrace. It's Grade II listed and was erected in 1882. John Lawrence was a prominent British imperial statesman who served as Viceroy of India from 1864 to 1869. The sculptor was Joseph Edgar Boehm, an Austrian-born artist who kept a large studio in London. He is best known for the Jubilee head of Queen Victoria on coinage, and for the Duke of Wellington statue at Hyde Park Corner.
